faqs.question: Can the tutor choose my daughter's three objects for her?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor who offers to is a reason to end the arrangement. The exhibition is submitted as her own work and the school checks it. A tutor may ask why she chose an object, argue that it does not illuminate the prompt, point out that two of her three duplicate each other, explain what the criteria reward, and mark a draft with comments. Choosing the objects, supplying a set of three that reliably score, drafting the commentary or rewriting passages of it are all out of bounds. She also cannot defend in a viva or a conversation choices she did not make herself.

faqs.question: What makes an object good enough for the exhibition?
faqs.answer: It does work the commentary could not do without it. The practical test is specificity of provenance: not a category of thing but this particular item, with a date, an origin and a history someone can describe. A photograph of a courtroom illustrates an idea about legal knowledge; a specific summons with a case number and a date lets a student argue about how claims get authorised and by whom. If the point survives when you swap the object for any similar one, the object is decoration and should be replaced before the writing starts.

faqs.question: My son's commentary describes the objects beautifully and barely mentions the prompt. Is that bad?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the single most common failure on this assessment. The examiner credits the link between object and prompt, so a long description followed by one connecting sentence leaves most of the available marks unclaimed. The fix is to write the link first, in explicit language that uses the prompt's own terms, then cut the description back to whatever that link actually needs. Students resist because explicit writing feels clumsy to them. Have him rewrite one paragraph that way and compare both versions against the criteria; the comparison usually settles the argument faster than advice does.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to Kharghar or Vashi for an evening session during deadline week?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the tutor is matched from inside Navi Mumbai. Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel sit a short drive from each other on Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, so two or three sessions in a fortnight are straightforward. What fails is pulling a specialist across the creek from the island city for repeated evening trips; the Atal Setu has shortened that journey without making it sustainable three times in ten days. If the only tutor who has marked exhibition work lives in the Western Suburbs, we will propose a hybrid pattern rather than book sessions that start cancelling.

faqs.question: What does our society gate need before a home tutor starts visiting?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once rather than treating them as a new visitor each time. Give the gate the name, phone number and the days and times, and ask whether your building wants written authorisation from the flat owner or an entry under your flat number in the visitor register. Many Mumbai complexes issue a recurring pass for tuition teachers, and some require app or intercom confirmation per visit. Settle it before the second session, because during a deadline fortnight a tutor held at the gate for fifteen minutes loses a serious part of a session you cannot reschedule.

faqs.question: Does the whole family need to be out of the house during a home session?
faqs.answer: Not at all, but the room needs to be quiet and the objects need to be accessible. This piece of work involves a tutor and a student handling physical things, reading small print and arguing about what an object shows, so a dining table with space and light works better than a bedroom. A parent in the next room is fine and sometimes useful, because household members often remember the provenance of an object better than the student does. What does not work is a television within earshot or a session interrupted every ten minutes.

faqs.question: My daughter wants to use an object connected to religion. Is that allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, and such objects can anchor strong work, provided the commentary analyses rather than asserts. The task is to examine how knowledge claims in that area are made, justified, transmitted and contested, attributing positions to the people and communities who hold them. It is not the task to establish whether a contested religious claim is true, and a commentary that argues for or against one has misread the assessment. A tutor should hold her to description and attribution throughout, and should keep their own views out of the room entirely. Cultural and political objects carry the same requirement.

faqs.question: Can an object have a personal family story attached to it?
faqs.answer: Yes, and many of the strongest exhibitions use one. The error is letting the story do the work the argument should do. A grandmother's ration card is a genuinely good object because of what it records and who was entitled to read and act on it, not because it is moving. So the commentary has to say what the object shows about how knowledge is produced, trusted or shared, and then use the family history as evidence for that claim. If you remove the sentimental sentences and the argument collapses, there was no argument.

faqs.question: How many sessions does exhibition work usually take?
faqs.answer: Fewer than families expect, because the work is short and deadline-bound. A common pattern is one session on object selection well before the deadline, one or two on the draft, and a final session to mark the complete commentary against the criteria. Some students need only the selection conversation. Others, particularly those who write fluently and argue implicitly, need more draft work than they think. We would rather arrange three useful sessions than sell a term of weekly ones for a piece of work that does not need them.

faqs.question: How much does a Theory of Knowledge home tutor charge in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Tutors set their own rates, so we explain the variables instead of publishing figures. The number moves with the board and level, with how scarce the specialism is, with session length and frequency, with travel distance and the hour of day, and with whether reading a draft between sessions is included. Tutors who have actually marked exhibition work are scarcer than general Diploma Programme tutors, which affects the rate more than distance does. Ask two or three the same questions about what a session includes and what notice they need for a cancellation, then compare.

faqs.question: What if the tutor is too directive and starts shaping the work too much?
faqs.answer: Tell us immediately and we will take them off the project. A tutor who begins supplying sentences, rewriting paragraphs or steering a student towards a particular set of objects has crossed the line this assessment depends on, and the risk lands on your child rather than on them. We will re-match you the same week where we can, and we pass on the useful diagnosis without the drafting. If work has already been shaped that way, speak to the Theory of Knowledge teacher at school before submission rather than after it.

sections.heading: Where TOK sits in the IB Diploma Programme, and why DP1 is the cheap year to fix it
paragraphs: Theory of Knowledge is a core requirement of the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), sat alongside six subjects and the Extended Essay (EE) rather than as a seventh subject with its own textbook. Every DP candidate takes it, Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) students alike, which means it is the one course in your child's timetable where there is no option to drop down a level when it gets uncomfortable. It runs across both DP years, and it is assessed on work the student produces rather than on a sit-down examination, so the calendar matters more here than raw ability does.

The practical consequence for Mumbai families is that DP1 and DP2 are completely different purchases. A DP1 family booking a Theory of Knowledge (TOK) tutor in Mumbai is buying thinking time: the student has months to collect examples, test knowledge questions against real cases, and learn to say what a claim rests on. A DP2 family booking in the same week as a deadline is buying triage. Both are legitimate, but they are not the same service and nobody should pretend otherwise. If you have a DP1 student and the TOK reports are vague rather than alarming, this is the year where two sessions a month costs less and does more than a weekly crisis slot will cost in DP2.

Plenty of parents arrive having been told by their child that TOK does not count for much. It is part of the core, and it is reported alongside the Extended Essay, so it contributes to the Diploma rather than sitting outside it. We will not quote you a points table, because the IB revises assessment arrangements on its own cycle and your school's DP coordinator holds the version that applies to your child's cohort. What is stable is the skill: a student who can separate a claim from the reasoning behind it does better in History essays, Biology discussions and university interviews as well.

Written out as a label, a Theory of Knowledge (TOK) IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai parents can book is simply a specialist who works across both years rather than parachuting in at the end. That continuity is the whole product.

sections.heading: The two pieces of TOK work, and what a tutor can legitimately touch
paragraphs: TOK is assessed through two pieces of work. The exhibition asks the student to choose three objects and explain, in commentary, how each one connects to a prompt taken from the published list in the current subject guide. The essay is written on a prescribed title released by the IB for that session. Those are the deliverables. Everything else in the course, the core theme about knowledge and the knower, the optional themes, the areas of knowledge, exists to give the student something to think with when they sit down to produce them.

The exhibition is where remote work pays off immediately, because the objects are usually photographs on a phone. A student in Chembur who wants to use her grandmother's ration card, a cricket scorecard and a WhatsApp forward can hold all three up to a camera and talk, and the tutor can see the object and the student's face at the same time. The commonest exhibition failure is not a bad object. It is a good object described rather than used: the student explains what the ration card is instead of what it shows about how knowledge gets certified by an institution. A tutor's job is to keep asking what work the object is doing until the student can say it in one sentence.

The essay runs on a prescribed title, and the single most important rule in the course is that the title is used exactly as the IB sets it. It is never reworded, never narrowed to something more comfortable, never turned into a topic the student would rather write about. A tutor who helps a student quietly rewrite the title into an easier question has damaged the essay before a word of it is drafted. Reading the title closely is the skill, and it belongs to the student.

TOK runs straight through religion, politics, culture and history, and a tutor working on it has to be careful. The discipline we ask for is attribution: a position is reported as held by the people who hold it, with their reasons stated fairly, and the tutor does not advance a personal view on a contested religious or political claim. The student's own view is the student's to form. What a tutor corrects is sloppy reasoning, a caricatured opponent, or a sweeping claim about a community offered as if it were evidence. For structure, components and current wording, read the subject guide your school issues rather than anything a tutoring site tells you.

What those calendars share is the shape of the squeeze. In DP1 the exhibition work usually surfaces in the second half of the year, often arriving in the same weeks as the first serious Internal Assessment (IA) drafts. In DP2 the essay sits in a corridor between the start of the school year and the internal deadline the school sets ahead of the IB's, which schools pull forward precisely because they know what else is happening.

The pressure points, in order of how often they ruin a term: the stretch after the Diwali break when DP2 students come back to find an essay deadline and two IA deadlines in the same fortnight; the mock examination window, when TOK stops entirely and three weeks of momentum evaporate; and the final run into the May session, by which point the TOK work should be finished and is sometimes not. A DP2 student in Vikhroli with a History IA, a Chemistry IA draft and a TOK essay outline due inside ten days is not short of ability. She is short of hours, and the fix is sequencing rather than more tuition.

Which is why we ask for your school's internal dates in the first message. A tutor who knows your campus pulls the essay work two weeks earlier than the deadline implies, and books nothing in your mock fortnight instead of charging you for sessions your child will attend exhausted.

sections.heading: Is online TOK tuition really as good as home tuition in Mumbai?
paragraphs: For Theory of Knowledge, honestly, yes, and this is the only IB subject where we say that without hedging. Home tuition remains IB Gram's lead service across Mumbai, and for a DP2 student who needs a tutor physically next to her while she rebuilds an essay plan on paper, an IB home tutor in Mumbai is still the better buy. But TOK is argument and typing. There is no apparatus, no board work, no diagram the tutor has to draw over the student's shoulder. The essay is uploaded rather than handwritten, which means the entire production chain already lives in a document on a laptop.

Home tuition's real advantages here are attention and accountability. A tutor sitting at your dining table in Khar West gets a student who cannot open another tab, and a parent who can see that the hour happened. IB home tuition in Mumbai also suits the student who will simply not argue with a face on a screen, and there are such students. The cost is travel: a weekly 7pm slot that depends on Ghodbunder Road or the Powai approach off JVLR will be cancelled or shortened several times a term, and those cancellations land in the weeks you can least afford them.

Online removes that failure mode and adds one of its own. A student can go quiet behind a camera in a way she cannot at a table, so an online TOK tutor has to work harder, which is why we match on argument ability rather than on availability. The compensation is that an IB online tutor in Mumbai can work in a shared document with the student in real time, leaving an objection in the margin beside the exact sentence that caused it. A home tutor reading a printout cannot do that, and a student rereading her own essay next week sees the objection and the sentence together.

Hybrid is what most of our TOK families settle into: weekly online argument sessions, plus a home visit before the exhibition submission and another before the essay goes up. A home tutor for Theory of Knowledge (TOK) Mumbai families book for those two visits costs more per hour once travel is priced in, and it is usually worth it twice a year rather than weekly.

sections.heading: How TOK tutors are checked across Mumbai, and what you should check yourself
paragraphs: Before a tutor appears on any shortlist we check identity and qualifications against documents, confirm the IB teaching or examining experience they claim, and interview them on the subject. For TOK the interview is unusual: we hand the tutor a prescribed title and ask them to build an argument, then we take the other side. Anyone who answers in generalities about truth and perception does not make the list. We also ask what they would do if a student asked them to write a paragraph, because the wrong answer there is disqualifying regardless of how well the rest went.

Your own checks are the ones that matter most, and they are easy. Ask the tutor which areas of knowledge they are strongest in and which they avoid, because an honest answer is a good sign and a claim of total coverage is not. Ask them to explain how an exhibition object does analytical work. Ask what they will do if your child's draft is good but answers a question adjacent to the prescribed title rather than the title itself. Be wary of any tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, promises a specific grade, or treats TOK as a formula with slots to fill. We do not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor in this subject will.

The boundary we hold on every TOK and Extended Essay booking is simple to state and non-negotiable in practice. The work must be the student's own. A tutor may teach skills, question a knowledge question until it is sharper, explain what a criterion is asking for, and comment on a draft the student has already written. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or supply any part of the essay or the commentary, and any use of artificial intelligence tools is declared under your school's own rules, not ours. If a tutor sends back a paragraph your child did not write, tell us and the booking ends that day.

One more thing to verify yourself, since an IB DP Theory of Knowledge online tutor in Mumbai works where you cannot see them. Sit in the room for the first fifteen minutes of session one, or ask for the session link on your own device. Hearing one exchange tells you more about whether this tutor can press your child than any profile will, wherever in Mumbai either of them happens to be sitting.

sections.heading: What a TOK session over video actually looks like, hour by hour
paragraphs: TOK is not learned by being explained to. It is learned by being pressed, which is why the format of a remote session matters more here than the technology does. The core of every session we would call good is a position and an opponent. The student states a position, defends it, and the tutor argues the other side properly rather than politely. Then they swap: the tutor hands over the position the student was just attacking and asks her to defend it. Students hate the swap for about three weeks and then start arriving with the counter-argument already prepared, which is the whole point. A student who has had to defend both sides of a claim about whether historians can be objective stops writing essays that only quote agreement.

The second thing a remote session does better than a table does is marking. The tutor opens the student's draft in a shared document and leaves objections beside the sentences that caused them, so the comment lives next to the claim rather than at the bottom of a printed page. When the student goes back three days later she reads her own sentence and the question it failed to survive in the same glance. A tutor working from a printout in your living room writes a general note at the end. Both are useful; only one of them is still useful next month. And because the essay is typed and uploaded rather than handwritten, nothing has to be transcribed out of the session back into the real deliverable.

The third is memory across two years, and it is the part families underestimate. From session one, the tutor and student keep one shared file with three running lists: knowledge questions the student has met, examples she can actually use, and counter-examples that break those examples. A newspaper story about a retracted study goes in under the natural sciences. A disagreement in class about whether a translated poem is the same poem goes in under the arts. By the time the prescribed titles arrive in DP2, the student is not starting from nothing. She has eighteen months of her own material, in her own words, and the essay planning session becomes a matter of selection rather than invention. Nobody can build that file in a six-week sprint.

Between those three things, TOK ends up unusually well suited to remote work: argument needs a voice, marking needs a cursor, and continuity needs a file, and none of the three needs a tutor in your building.

sections.heading: What should TOK progress look like at four weeks, one term and one cycle?
paragraphs: At four weeks you are not looking for better marks. You are looking for a change in how your child talks. The specific thing to listen for is a second question: she states a position and then, unprompted, asks what would have to be true for it to be wrong. If after a month she is still answering TOK questions with a summary of what she believes, the sessions are being delivered as lectures and you should say so. Four weeks is also enough to tell you whether she actually arrives having thought about anything between sessions, which is the single best predictor of where this ends up.

At one term the markers are concrete. She should be able to take a prescribed title and say what it is asking in her own words without changing what it asks. She should have three or four examples she can use in more than one direction, and at least one counter-example she found herself. If the exhibition is behind her, she should be able to explain what each object did rather than what each object was. A draft at this point will usually still have the commonest fault in the subject, which is answering a question near the title instead of the title, and a tutor who spots that and makes her fix it is earning the fee.

Over a full cycle the honest picture includes the cases where this does not work. Some students will not argue, with a tutor or anyone else, and TOK punishes that more than any other course in the Diploma. Some arrive in February of DP2 with nothing banked, and a tutor can then help them produce a competent piece of work on a title they have barely read, which is a repair job and should be described as one. We do not guarantee grades, and anyone in this market who does is selling you something else. What tuition reliably buys is a student who has been argued with regularly by someone who knew the course.

Parents also ask the uncomfortable question: is a weekly session for two years worth it for a core requirement rather than a subject? Our honest answer is that fortnightly across DP1 plus weekly for the essay stretch in DP2 beats weekly throughout, costs less, and produces the same work. A tutor who tells you your child needs two sessions a week for TOK from day one is managing their own calendar, not your child's.

sections.heading: Starting TOK online or home tuition in Mumbai: what to send, what it costs
paragraphs: Three things make the first message useful: your child's DP year, the current TOK deadline from the school's own calendar, and a photograph of the last piece of TOK feedback she received, however thin. If the exhibition is live, the three objects she is considering help enormously. If the essay is live, the prescribed title she has chosen matters more than anything else you could send, because the tutor reads it before the session rather than during it. You do not need a diagnostic test. There is no test in this subject worth taking.

On fees, we will not print a rate card, because the honest answer is that IB tuition fees in Mumbai move with several things at once. Level and board set the floor. Scarcity matters more in TOK than in Maths, because far fewer tutors can teach it well. Session length changes the per-hour figure, since ninety minutes of argument is a different product from sixty. Travel is the big one: a home tutor crossing Mumbai for a weekday evening is pricing an hour of teaching plus two of traffic, which is why online sessions in this subject usually land lower than the same tutor's home rate. Ask any prospective tutor to quote online and home rates separately and you will see the gap immediately.

Session one is deliberately uncomfortable. The tutor asks your child what she thinks about something in her own course, then argues against her for twenty minutes and makes her defend the other side. After that they look at either the three objects or the prescribed title and open the shared file. You get a short written note the same evening saying where the reasoning actually broke, which is more useful than a mark and harder to produce. If that note reads like a template, tell us and we will shortlist again.

Parents searching variations of IB tutors near me Mumbai usually end up on a page like this one wanting to know whether anyone will tell them the truth about what tuition can and cannot do. For TOK: it can teach a student to argue, to attribute positions fairly to the people who hold them, and to write an essay that answers the title it was given. It cannot do the thinking, and it should not try.

faqs.question: Can online TOK sessions really work, or should I book an IB private tutor Mumbai families use at home?
faqs.answer: Online works well for this subject specifically, and an IB private tutor Mumbai parents bring home is the better choice only for a student who will not engage with a screen. TOK needs argument, a shared document and a running file of examples. It needs no apparatus, no board work and no handwriting, because the essay and the exhibition commentary are typed and uploaded. The usual compromise is weekly online sessions with a home visit before each submission. Book a first session in whichever format you prefer and judge from the hour itself rather than from our opinion of it.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to our building in Thane or Navi Mumbai for an evening TOK session?
faqs.answer: Yes, within the node or corridor the tutor already lives in, which is why we match Thane tutors to Thane families and Navi Mumbai tutors across Vashi, Nerul, Belapur and Kharghar. A tutor pulled across the creek or down Ghodbunder Road for a 7pm weekday slot will manage it for a few weeks and then start cancelling, and for TOK those cancelled hours are the expensive ones. If your preferred slot is a weekday evening in Kasarvadavali or Panvel, run the weekly session online and save the home visits for weekends before a deadline.

faqs.question: What does a tutor do about the TOK essay title my child has chosen?
faqs.answer: A tutor reads it with her, repeatedly, and does not change a word of it. The prescribed title is used exactly as the IB sets it, so the work is noticing precisely what it asks, including which knowledge claims it covers and which it quietly excludes. The commonest failure in the whole course is a well-written essay answering a question adjacent to the title. A tutor's job is to catch that early, ask which sentence of the title a given paragraph serves, and make the student answer the question she was actually given rather than the one she finds more interesting.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help write or fix the essay if my child is out of time?
faqs.answer: No. A tutor may teach skills, press on a knowledge question, explain what a criterion asks for, and comment on a draft your child has written. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or supply any part of the essay or the exhibition commentary. Any use of artificial intelligence tools is declared under your school's rules, and your child's TOK work is her own submission. If a tutor returns text your child did not write, tell us and we end the booking. What we can do late is help her produce competent work quickly, which is repair rather than teaching.

faqs.question: Is TOK worth paying for when it is not one of the six subjects?
faqs.answer: It is part of the Diploma core and is reported alongside the Extended Essay, so it contributes rather than sitting outside. Your DP coordinator holds the current assessment arrangements for your child's cohort and that is the right source for the mechanics. The stronger argument for tuition is transfer: the student who can separate a claim from its reasoning writes better History and Economics essays and interviews better. If budget is the question, fortnightly sessions in DP1 and weekly only through the DP2 essay stretch is the pattern we recommend most often.

faqs.question: How much does Theory of Knowledge (TOK) tuition cost, and what makes it more expensive than Maths?
faqs.answer: Scarcity, mainly. Fewer tutors across Mumbai teach TOK convincingly than teach DP Mathematics, so the rate sits higher for the same hour. Beyond that, fees move with level, session length and travel: a tutor crossing the city for a weekday evening prices the traffic as well as the teaching, which is why online sessions in this subject usually quote lower than home visits with the same tutor. We publish no price list and would distrust any site that did. Ask for online and home rates separately before you commit to a term.

faqs.question: My child's exhibition objects feel random. Can a tutor choose better ones?
faqs.answer: A tutor can question them until your child chooses better ones herself, which is a different thing. The test is never whether an object is impressive. It is whether the object does analytical work against the prompt your child selected from the published list. A ration card, a cricket scorecard and a retracted research paper can all work; a famous painting nobody in the room cares about usually does not. Expect the tutor to ask what each object shows about how knowledge is produced or certified, and to keep asking until the answer fits in one sentence.

faqs.question: TOK touches religion and politics. How do you keep a tutor from pushing their own views?
faqs.answer: We interview for it and we hold the line in writing. A tutor's job in TOK is to make sure a position is attributed to the people who actually hold it, with their reasons stated fairly, and to correct a caricature or a sweeping claim offered as evidence. The tutor does not advance a personal view on a contested religious, political or cultural claim, and does not tell your child what to conclude. What gets corrected is reasoning: unsupported generalisation, a strawman opponent, or an example that does not show what the student says it shows.

faqs.question: What happens at home if the tutor is not working out after three sessions?
faqs.answer: You message us and we shortlist again, usually within two or three working days. No notice period, no persuasion call, and you pay only for sessions already taken. TOK mismatches are more often about temperament than competence: some tutors explain beautifully and never push, and a student who is never pushed does not improve in this subject. Tell us specifically what was missing, because it changes who we send next. The commonest useful feedback we get is some version of nobody argued with her, and that is an easy brief to match against.

faqs.question: Do we need a quiet study space and a parent at home for online sessions?
faqs.answer: A door that closes matters more than a desk. For online TOK the student needs to be able to talk loudly and be wrong out loud, which does not happen in a living room with family watching television. A laptop rather than a phone makes the shared-document marking work properly. A parent does not need to sit in, though we suggest listening to the first fifteen minutes of session one so you hear whether this tutor can press your child. After that, the same-evening written note tells you what happened.

faqs.question: Can the same tutor help with the Extended Essay as well?
faqs.answer: Often yes, and many TOK tutors across Mumbai also supervise-adjacent work on the Extended Essay, but the roles are different and should stay separate in your head. The Extended Essay has a school-appointed supervisor who runs the formal reflection sessions and signs off the process, and a private tutor never replaces that person or contacts the school. If you want both, say so when you ask, and we will shortlist tutors who can teach research method and argument structure without stepping into the supervisor's role.

faqs.question: Which Mumbai areas do you actually cover for TOK?
faqs.answer: All six zones, with named tutors in South Mumbai from Colaba to Worli, the Western Suburbs from Bandra to Dahisar East, the Central Suburbs including Powai and Ghatkopar, the Eastern Suburbs from Chembur to Mulund, Navi Mumbai across Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, and Thane along Pokhran and Ghodbunder Roads. For online sessions the zone is irrelevant and you draw from the full city pool, which is the real advantage. For home visits we match within your corridor, because a tutor crossing Mumbai weekly in the evening peak will not sustain it for two years.

sections.heading: How IB Gram builds a TOK shortlist for a Mumbai family
paragraphs: The request that arrives most often is not find me a TOK tutor. It is a parent forwarding a coordinator's written comment on a draft, or a parent noticing that a DP2 student has stopped mentioning the subject entirely. So the first question we ask is what the actual problem is, because the answer changes the match completely. A student who cannot find a second perspective on a prescribed title needs a different tutor from a student who already has three perspectives and cannot order them into an argument that holds together.

We ask for four things before shortlisting anyone: the school and its internal TOK deadline, which prescribed title the student has chosen or is choosing between, whether the exhibition is already submitted, and what the supervising teacher has said in writing. The last of those matters more than parents expect. A comment such as your claims are not supported by examples tells a tutor exactly where to begin, and it stops the first session being spent rediscovering something the school diagnosed weeks earlier. It also keeps the tutor working with the school's reading of the draft rather than against it.

Then we match on travel, not on a map. An IB DP Theory of Knowledge private tutor in Mumbai who lives in Chembur and teaches in Bandra on a Wednesday evening will start cancelling by the third week, whatever the enthusiasm in week one. We match inside a corridor where we can and move to online where we cannot, and we tell you which of the two we are doing. A shortlist is normally two or three tutors with a short note on what each is stronger at, and you speak to them before anything is booked or paid for.

sections.heading: Where TOK sits in the IB Diploma Programme, and why that changes the decision
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) is six subjects plus a core of three parts: Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay (EE), and Creativity, Activity, Service. The six subjects carry the bulk of the final result. The core contributes a smaller number of points, awarded on the combination of the TOK and EE grades together. We deliberately do not print the points matrix here, because the IB revises its documentation on its own cycle; ask the school's DP coordinator for the version that applies to the year your child actually sits.

That structure is the whole argument of this page. The points at stake in TOK are real. A family that treats the core as decoration can find in July that it cost them the difference between two offers. They are also small next to six subjects, which means TOK tuition is a choice against something, not a free addition. If a student is sitting on a weak grade in a Higher Level (HL) subject, the same money and the same two hours a week almost always do more good there. Spending on both at once, in DP2, is how students end up tired in every subject.

Timing changes the answer too. In DP1 the subject is mostly discussion and the exhibition, and a student who is lost in DP1 usually has time to find their feet without paid help. By the middle of DP2 the prescribed titles are out, the essay has a school deadline, and time has become the scarce thing rather than understanding. The same student, with the same confusion, is a reasonable candidate for tuition in January of DP2 and a poor one in August of DP1. Parents searching for an IB private tutor Mumbai families recommend often have the right instinct at the wrong moment.

sections.heading: What the TOK essay and exhibition actually ask a student to do
paragraphs: TOK is assessed on two pieces of work. The exhibition asks a student to select objects and connect them to one of the IB's prompts, explaining how each object shows that prompt at work in the real world. The essay responds to one prescribed title released by the IB for that session, and the title is fixed; a student may not rewrite it into a question they prefer. Both reward the same habit, which is why the subject rewards pressure: a clear knowledge claim, a real and specific example, and an honest answer to the obvious objection.

Where students lose marks is rarely intelligence. It is that nothing in the essay is ever pinned down. A draft will say that scientists and historians approach evidence differently, name no scientist and no historian, and then move on. A good Theory of Knowledge (TOK) tutor in Mumbai spends most of a first session doing one thing: asking which claim, which example, and what somebody who disagreed would say. That is uncomfortable for about twenty minutes and then it becomes the most useful habit the student takes into their essay and, often, into their History or Biology writing too.

A tutor's job here has a hard edge to it. TOK involves questions about religion, politics, value and belief, and a tutor does not supply positions on any of them. The student's view is the student's view; the tutor's job is to ask whether it is argued, evidenced and tested against a counter-claim. Some parents write to us asking for a Theory of Knowledge (TOK) IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families can keep across both years, and that continuity works well, as long as everyone understands the tutor is teaching a method rather than handing over opinions.

sections.heading: TOK private tutors across all six Mumbai zones
paragraphs: TOK is one of the thinner subjects for supply in Mumbai, Maharashtra, because far fewer teachers have marked it than have marked Maths or Chemistry. That makes geography matter more, not less. In South Mumbai we match within the island: Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Churchgate, Walkeshwar, Babulnath, Tardeo and Worli. The distances look trivial and are not. A tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers a few kilometres and can still lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals at 6pm, so pulling someone down the Western Line for a weekday slot rarely survives a term.

The Western Suburbs are where most of our TOK requests come from, and they behave as a corridor. Bandra, Khar West, Santacruz West and Juhu match easily into each other; so do Andheri West, Versova and Goregaon East; so do Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar East. Matching along the Western Line or Metro Lines 2A and 7 works. Matching across the Western Express Highway at the evening peak does not. The Bandra-Worli Sea Link and the Coastal Road make a South Mumbai tutor viable in Bandra on a weekend morning and not on a Tuesday evening.

The Central Suburbs run on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off JVLR and no station of their own, so Powai tutors come by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar East; Kurla sits on the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road. In the Eastern Suburbs we cover Chembur, Govandi, Wadala, Vikhroli, Bhandup and Mulund West, where the Eastern Freeway and the Monorail make South Mumbai closer than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is matched node to node along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, with the Atal Setu and the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines in reserve. In Thane, Ghodbunder Road sets the timetable from Pokhran Road and Majiwada out to Kasarvadavali, and an IB DP Theory of Knowledge private tutor in Mumbai based near Thane station will quote you a different slot for Majiwada than for Kasarvadavali for exactly that reason.

sections.heading: How do Mumbai IB school calendars set the TOK pressure points?
paragraphs: Mumbai IB schools set internal TOK deadlines well before the IB's own upload dates, and those internal dates are the ones that decide whether a family needs help. At schools such as Dhirubhai Ambani International School and the American School of Bombay in Bandra Kurla Complex, Ecole Mondiale World School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Oberoi International School off JVLR, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath and Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, the pattern is similar even when the dates differ.

The pressure points stack. The exhibition usually clears in DP1 or early DP2. Then the prescribed titles arrive, the student picks one, a planning document goes in, a first draft is read once by the TOK teacher, and the final essay is due in the same stretch of weeks as two or three Internal Assessment (IA) drafts. A DP2 student at NES International School in Mulund West or D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul is often writing her TOK essay in the same fortnight as her Physics IA and her History paper. Mock exams land near that, too.

This is why we push families to decide early rather than well. A parent who looks at the calendar in October and books four or five sessions in November gets a student who writes the essay once. A parent who waits until the draft comes back marked in January is buying emergency work at the worst point of DP2. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page; we name these schools only because their calendars are the practical constraint, and because their published term dates are the right thing for you to plan around.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for TOK in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Home tuition is what most Mumbai families book for TOK and it is what we lead with. An IB home tutor in Mumbai at the dining table gets a reluctant student talking in a way a screen often does not, and the first job in TOK is talking: being asked what you mean, out loud, and not being allowed to drift. Home classes also remove the travel the student would otherwise do after a full school day, which in DP2 is worth more than it sounds. The cost is that IB home tuition in Mumbai is the most expensive mode and the least flexible on timing, because the tutor's travel is real time somebody has to pay for.

Online TOK tuition is genuinely good for one part of the work. Marking a draft while both people look at the same document, with comments sitting next to the student's own paragraphs, is better online than it is over a printed page. Online also opens up tutors who have actually marked TOK and happen to live in the wrong part of the city. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can take a 9pm slot that no home tutor can. What online loses is the pressure of a person sitting across the table waiting for you to finish a sentence.

Hybrid is what most of our TOK families end up on, and it is usually the right answer rather than a compromise. The pattern that works: home tuition for the first two or three sessions and before the draft, so the student does the uncomfortable talking in person, then online for the marking and the chase-up sessions. Hybrid also survives Mumbai monsoon weeks, when a tutor commuting from Andheri to Lower Parel will miss a Tuesday. An IB DP Theory of Knowledge private tutor in Mumbai should be willing to tell you which parts of the work they think belong at home and which do not.

sections.heading: How is a TOK tutor checked before you meet them?
paragraphs: Every tutor on IB Gram is checked on four things before an introduction: government photo identity, the degree they claim, where they have taught the IB and in what role, and whether they have actually taught or assessed the component the family needs. The fourth check is the one that matters for TOK, because many excellent IB subject teachers have never taught the core. A tutor who has taught DP Economics for nine years and has never read a TOK essay against the criteria is not a TOK tutor, and we will say so rather than place them.

There are checks only you can do, and we would rather you did them on the introductory call than discover them in week five. Ask whether the tutor has taught TOK inside a school or only tutored it privately. Ask them to describe the essay criteria in their own words and listen for whether they talk about knowledge claims and counter-claims or only about structure and word count. Ask what they would do with a draft that has good ideas and no examples. Ask how they handle a student whose view on a political or religious question they disagree with.

Ask the integrity question directly, because it is the one that separates a tutor from a problem. The work must be the student's own. A tutor may teach how to read a prescribed title, question a knowledge claim, and comment on a draft the student has written. A tutor may not write a paragraph, redraft a sentence into their own words, or supply examples for the student to insert. Any use of artificial intelligence tools has to be declared under the school's rules. A tutor who offers to tidy up the writing for you is telling you something, and the answer is no.

We also keep the commercial side plain. There is no exclusivity: tutors work on other platforms and independently, and the ones who have marked TOK are in demand. Be wary of anyone who offers a guaranteed grade on the core, or who tells you the TOK essay is easy once you know the formula. There is no formula. A search for the best IB tutor in Mumbai will not tell you who has sat in a moderation meeting, but twenty minutes on a call usually will.

sections.heading: When a TOK private tutor is worth it, and when it is not
paragraphs: The honest case for tuition is about classroom shape rather than ability. TOK is taught to a whole class, once or twice a week, by discussion. That format rewards students who are quick to speak and quietly ignores students who are not. A thoughtful student who answers when asked and never volunteers can go two terms without once being made to defend a claim, and the subject only works when someone pushes back. One-to-one supplies exactly that pressure. A tutor cannot let a student off; a classroom, with twenty-two students and forty minutes, has to.

The honest case against is just as common and we turn this work away regularly. A student who is engaging with TOK, arguing at dinner, bringing up the exhibition unprompted, and simply finds the subject strange and slippery does not usually need a tutor. They need time, and TOK is designed to feel strange for the first two terms. Paying someone to accelerate that often produces a student who has learned a tutor's moves rather than their own judgement, and it reads that way on the page. Reassessing the same student in February of DP2 is a better use of your money than booking in August of DP1.

The signals that separate the two cases are visible at home if you look. Worth it: a student who cannot tell you what their essay is arguing, or who tells you something different each time; a draft returned with comments the student cannot explain; silence about the subject combined with a drop in one or two other written subjects; a prescribed title chosen because it sounded easiest. Not worth it yet: confusion that the student can describe clearly, strong engagement in class, a draft that is thin but on topic, a student who says the subject is odd but interesting.

Then there is the deadline case, which is different from both. A DP2 student two or three weeks from an internal deadline with a weak draft is not a candidate for a term of tuition; they are a candidate for three or four tightly scoped sessions on the draft they already have. The realistic goal is a sharper claim, two real examples, and a counter-argument that is actually answered, not a rewrite. Nobody can promise a specific grade from that work, and an IB DP Theory of Knowledge private tutor in Mumbai who tells you otherwise two weeks out is selling you something. What those sessions buy is a finished essay that argues one thing, which is usually the difference that was missing.

The last piece is fit with a DP2 timetable that is already full. We cap most TOK work at one session a week, often shorter than a subject session, and we schedule it away from IA weeks rather than into them. A student who is giving up a Sunday morning for TOK while behind on two IAs is losing more than the core can return. That is the same arithmetic as the beginning of this page: six subjects first, core second, and TOK tuition only when it is buying something the class cannot.

sections.heading: What progress looks like, and what home classes cannot fix
paragraphs: At four weeks, the thing to look for is not a better grade. It is that your child can tell you, in two sentences and without hedging, what their TOK essay argues and what the strongest objection to it is. If they can do that in week four they are on track even if nothing has been marked yet. If they still cannot, either the tutor is not pressing or the title was a bad choice, and both are worth raising directly. Ask to see the tutor's written notes from each session; a TOK tutor who leaves no notes is hard to hold to anything.

At one term the measure is the draft and what the school says about it. A term of honest work usually shows up as comments moving from your claims are unsupported towards questions about the balance of the counter-argument, which is a much better place to be. At one exam cycle you find out what the core was worth, in points, and whether the habit transferred. The commonest good side effect we hear about is a History or Psychology teacher noticing that the student has started writing against the question rather than around it.

The limits are worth saying plainly. We do not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor will. Tuition cannot fix a prescribed title the student does not understand and will not change, a student who has not done the reading in their own subjects, or four weeks of missed school. It also cannot replace the TOK teacher, who sees the class, the cohort and the school's internal standard. If a tutor is not working, tell us in the first three weeks; we will re-shortlist and you are not locked into anything. Changing tutor once in DP2 is normal and usually better than enduring a bad fit.

faqs.question: Is TOK tuition worth it if my child is doing fine in her six subjects?
faqs.answer: Often it is not, and that is the honest answer. The core carries real points but fewer than a single subject grade, so an IB DP Theory of Knowledge private tutor in Mumbai is money and DP2 hours taken from somewhere else. If the six subjects are solid and the TOK draft is thin but on topic, four or five sessions around the essay deadline is usually enough. If one Higher Level subject is sitting a grade below target, spend there first. We would rather tell you that on the call than sell you a term of weekly sessions you do not need.

faqs.question: My daughter says TOK is strange but she enjoys it. Does she need a tutor?
faqs.answer: Probably not yet. TOK is built to feel strange for the first two terms, and a student who is arguing about it at home is doing the subject correctly. Tuition at that stage tends to teach a tutor's moves rather than the student's own judgement, which examiners notice. The better plan is to wait until the prescribed titles are released and the first draft has been read by her TOK teacher, then look again. If she can describe her confusion clearly, she is thinking. If she cannot tell you what her essay argues, that is the signal to act.

faqs.question: Her TOK essay is due in three weeks and the draft is weak. What can a tutor actually do?
faqs.answer: Three or four tightly scoped sessions on the draft she already has, nothing more ambitious. The realistic work is narrowing the claim so the essay argues one thing, finding two real and specific examples to replace the vague ones, and writing the paragraph that answers the obvious objection instead of ignoring it. A tutor will not write or rewrite any of it; she does the writing and the tutor marks it against the published criteria. Nobody can promise a specific grade from a late rescue, but a finished essay that argues one point clearly is usually what was missing.

faqs.question: Should we spend on TOK or on her HL Chemistry instead?
faqs.answer: On the HL subject, in most cases. A subject grade moves more points than the core does, and a DP2 student can absorb one weekly tuition slot without losing sleep but rarely two. The exception is when the TOK essay is actively at risk, because an unfinished or very weak core piece has consequences beyond its points. The sensible sequence for most Mumbai families is subject tuition as the standing commitment, then a short block of TOK sessions timed around the essay deadline. Treat TOK as a choice against something, never as an addition on top.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for a subject like TOK?
faqs.answer: Four things, mainly: the level, how scarce the component is, the session length, and how far the tutor travels to you. TOK sits at the scarce end because far fewer teachers have assessed it than have assessed Maths or Physics, so experienced core markers are priced accordingly. Home tuition costs more than online because the tutor's travel time is real time. A home tutor coming from Andheri to Cuffe Parade on a weekday evening prices that commute in. We do not publish a rate card; the tutor quotes their own rate and you hear it before the trial session.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our building in Lower Parel for an evening slot?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and Lower Parel is one of the easier addresses in South Mumbai for it, because tutors reach it from Parel, Worli, Dadar and the Eastern Freeway side. The practical constraint is the hour. A 6pm start means a tutor leaving the Western Suburbs at the worst possible time, so we try to match from inside the island or move the slot to 7.30pm. For weekday evenings in high-rise Lower Parel addresses we also ask about lift wait times at peak, which sounds absurd until it costs ten minutes of a session.

faqs.question: Our society gate will not let anyone in without prior approval. How is that handled?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once as a standing weekly visitor rather than approving entry session by session. Most Mumbai societies, from Hiranandani Gardens in Powai to the Palm Beach Road complexes in Navi Mumbai, allow a recurring entry under a resident's name with a photo identity on file. We give you the tutor's full name and identity details to submit, and the tutor carries the same identity to the gate. The failure mode is the one-off: a rescheduled Saturday session that nobody told the guard about, with the tutor waiting at the gate while the session clock runs.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during home classes?
faqs.answer: No, but someone should be in the flat, and most Mumbai families prefer it. TOK sessions involve argument, which sounds like disagreement from the next room; parents who sit in tend to answer for the student, which defeats the purpose. The arrangement that works is a parent at home, a session in a room with the door open, and a five-minute handover at the end. Ask for the tutor's written session notes instead of listening in. For a first session with a new home tutor, being present for the introduction is reasonable.

faqs.question: Does online TOK tuition work as well as a tutor at home?
faqs.answer: For marking a draft, better. For getting a quiet student to argue out loud, worse. Online is strong when both people are looking at the same document and the tutor's comments sit next to the student's own paragraphs, and it opens up TOK markers who live across the city. What it loses is the pressure of someone sitting across the table waiting for the sentence to finish, which is the specific thing one-to-one TOK buys. Most of our families run hybrid: home tuition for the thinking sessions, online for marking and short check-ins.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Raise it in week four, not week ten. Ask the tutor for the session notes and one specific thing the student can now do that they could not in week one. In TOK that should be concrete: she can state her knowledge claim, or she has two real examples where she had none. If the notes are vague, the tutor is probably teaching structure rather than reasoning, which is the commonest failure on this subject. Tell us and we re-shortlist. A month is enough to judge direction, even though it is not enough to judge a grade.

faqs.question: What if the tutor is simply not working out?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we replace them, usually within a few days, and you are not tied into a package. Mismatch on TOK is often not about competence. A tutor who presses hard suits a student who has gone quiet and overwhelms a student who is already anxious about the essay. We ask what specifically is not working, because that detail makes the second match better: too gentle, too fast, too focused on templates, or simply the wrong time of day for a tired DP2 student. Changing once during DP2 is common and better than enduring a poor fit.

faqs.question: Will a tutor help write or edit my child's TOK essay?
faqs.answer: No. The essay has to be the student's own work, and a tutor who offers to rewrite or tidy it is creating an academic integrity problem for your child, not solving one. What a legitimate tutor does is teach how to read a prescribed title, question a knowledge claim until it is precise, press for real examples, and comment on a draft the student has already written. Any use of artificial intelligence tools must be declared under the school's rules. The TOK teacher at school remains the person who assesses the work and advises on the school's internal standard.

You speak to them, run one trial session, and decide after reading the notes. Nothing is owed if you stop there.

sections.heading: Where TOK sits in the IB Diploma Programme across DP1 and DP2
paragraphs: Theory of Knowledge (TOK) is part of the Diploma Programme core, alongside the Extended Essay (EE) and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS). It is not a subject your child chose and cannot be a subject your child drops. Every Diploma Programme (DP) student at every IB school in the city takes it, and it runs across both years rather than sitting in one. Most Mumbai schools timetable it as a single weekly period, which is why it so often becomes the lesson that gets surrendered to a Physics practical or a mock revision block.

The starting point differs more than parents expect. A student arriving from the Middle Years Programme (MYP) at Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu has already written reflections and has some vocabulary for talking about how a conclusion was reached. A student arriving from IGCSE at Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort or Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo has usually spent two years being rewarded for accurate recall and clear method. Both can do well. They need different first sessions, and a tutor who cannot tell the two apart wastes a month.

TOK and the Extended Essay are assessed together as the diploma core, and the current subject guide sets out how that works for your child's cohort. We deliberately do not print weightings, mark totals or submission dates on this page: the IB revises guides on its own cycle and your school's DP coordinator holds the version that applies to the year your child actually sits. Ask the coordinator for the internal draft dates and bring them to the first session.

The practical consequence is a two-year shape. DP1 is where the habits are built and where most schools run the exhibition. DP2 is where the essay on a prescribed title is written while six subjects are also producing internal assessments. A Theory of Knowledge (TOK) IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families book early tends to work in short, regular sessions across that whole span rather than a rescue block in February.

sections.heading: What does a TOK tutor teach when there is nothing to revise?
paragraphs: Four moves, essentially. Framing a knowledge question so that it asks about knowledge rather than about a topic. Separating a claim from the example that is meant to support it. Testing an argument against the case that would break it. And writing with enough precision that a reader cannot mistake the position being taken. There is no content to revise, so that set of moves is the entire teachable substance of a Theory of Knowledge (TOK) tutor in Mumbai session.

The first move is the one that unblocks students fastest. A DP1 student fascinated by the suburban railway timetable usually arrives wanting to write about trains. The TOK version of that interest asks how a model of a network can count as knowledge of the network, and what is lost when the model is tidier than the thing it describes. A student who loves classical dance arrives wanting to write about dance; the TOK version asks how a practitioner knows a movement is correct when the standard lives in a teacher's body rather than in a document. Same curiosity, rebuilt as a question about knowing.

The second and third moves are drilled rather than explained. A tutor takes a sentence from the student's own page, asks which part is the claim and which part is the illustration, and keeps asking until the student can see the join. Then the tutor supplies the awkward counter-case and makes the student answer it in writing. Where a title touches religion, politics or culture, the work is to set out how each position is argued and to attribute it to those who hold it. A good tutor examines how such claims are justified and takes no side on the question itself, which is also what the published criteria reward.

The two assessed pieces, the essay on a prescribed title and the exhibition of three objects, each sit on those moves. Structure, length and criteria wording come from the current subject guide rather than from this page or from a tutor's memory of an older edition. A tutor's job is to teach the moves, question the student's choices and comment on drafts the student has written. Writing, redrafting or supplying any part of the work is out of bounds, the prescribed title is used exactly as set and never reworded, and any use of artificial intelligence is declared under the school's own rules.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar that sets TOK deadlines
paragraphs: IB schools in Mumbai, Maharashtra mostly run from June to March or April, which puts the TOK pressure points in places parents do not expect. The monsoon arrives in the same weeks as the new DP1 cohort, so the first term of TOK is taught in the wettest months of the year and is also the term most often shortened by closures. Nothing is assessed then, which is exactly why it is the best term to start: a tutor can build the four moves while the stakes are still low.

The autumn stretch between Ganesh Chaturthi and Diwali is when the exhibition work tends to land for DP1 students, and the long Diwali break is when DP2 students are supposed to be making progress on the essay and frequently are not. January and February bring school mock examinations across six subjects, and that is the fortnight where TOK is dropped first. A DP2 student in Chembur with a Chemistry internal assessment due, a mock timetable on the wall and a TOK draft awaiting a second look will put the draft last every time unless somebody has already scheduled it.

Which school a child attends changes the shape of this. Naming a school here is context, nothing more. sections.heading: Home tuition, online sessions or a hybrid in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Home tuition is the default and for most families it is the right default. An IB home tutor in Mumbai sitting at the dining table can see the student's handwriting, watch where the pen stops, and notice the paragraph that was copied from a classmate's plan. TOK is argued out loud before it is written down, and a room with two people in it produces a sharper argument than a room with one person and a screen. For DP1 students who have not yet learned to be pressed on a claim, IB home tuition in Mumbai does something a video call struggles to replicate.

Online earns its place in three specific situations. A scarce match is the first: TOK specialists are thinner on the ground than Maths tutors, and an IB online tutor in Mumbai from a different zone may simply be better than the nearest available person. Traffic is the second. Ghodbunder Road at 6.30pm, the Western Express Highway in the rain and the Peddar Road signals all end weekly slots that looked fine in June. The third is drafting: marking a paragraph in a shared document, with objections typed beside the student's own sentences, genuinely works.

Hybrid is what most families settle into without planning it. Two home sessions a month for the hard conversations about a title or an object choice, and the rest online for draft work. An IB DP Theory of Knowledge tutor in Mumbai running that pattern keeps continuity through the monsoon and through mock season, which is when fully home-based arrangements tend to break. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) home classes Mumbai families book in DP1 often shift to this pattern by the second term of DP2.

Whichever shape you choose, protect the slot. A fixed weekly hour that nobody renegotiates is worth more than a longer session that moves every week, because TOK progress comes from repeated small pressure rather than from marathon sittings. Parents who treat the TOK hour as optional when a Physics test appears end up paying for the same ground twice.

paragraphs: Every tutor on the platform submits government photo identification, their degree and teaching documents, and a written account of their IB teaching history with the schools and years named. For the core we ask for something extra: a short written critique of an anonymised student paragraph. That one task separates a candidate who can argue about knowledge from a candidate who can only talk about it, and it is the single most predictive thing in the file. References from previous families are checked by phone, not by email form.

Your own checks matter more than ours, because you can see the fit and we cannot. Ask the tutor to read your child's prescribed title and say in two sentences what it is asking. Ask how they handle a weak draft: the right answer involves questions and marginal comments, never a rewritten paragraph. Ask what they do when a student's chosen object does not actually illuminate the prompt. An IB DP Theory of Knowledge tutor in Mumbai worth booking will answer all three without reaching for a sales line.

There is one boundary to state in full, because families get caught out by it. The work must be the student's own. A tutor may question a choice, teach the moves, model the technique on a different example and comment on a draft the student wrote. A tutor may not write, redraft or supply any part of the essay or the commentary, the prescribed title must not be altered, and any use of artificial intelligence is declared under the school's rules. Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, and be equally wary of one who offers to tidy up a draft over the weekend.

The commercial checks are simpler. Agree the session length, the cancellation window and how you will be told about a missed slot before the first lesson rather than after the first dispute. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents hire directly can be excellent, but ask the same questions you would ask us, and write the answers down.
