sections.heading: How are tutors verified, and what should a Mumbai parent check themselves?
paragraphs: Every IB and IGCSE tutor for Witty International School students in Mumbai on our panel has had identity and qualification documents checked, has been asked component level questions about the syllabus they claim to teach, and has given contactable references from previous families. That is what verification means here, and it is deliberately narrow. We check that a person is who they say they are and has taught what they say they have taught. We do not and cannot verify anything about any school, including Witty International School, with which IB Gram is not affiliated.

What we cannot check is fit, and fit is where most placements fail. So there are three things worth doing yourself, and they take ten minutes. Ask the tutor which syllabus code they are teaching to and whether it changes for the next series. Ask them to talk through one question from your child's last marked paper, with the paper in front of them. Then ask what they will be able to tell you after four weeks that they cannot tell you now. A tutor who answers all three concretely is a tutor who has done this before.

On a handover specifically, add a fourth question: what will you want from the previous tutor? The right answer is specific. The last marked draft, the error log, the past paper scores broken down by component, the IA stage and the school's own internal deadlines. A tutor who says they prefer to start fresh is telling you they intend to re-teach ground your child has already covered, and in January that is a term you do not have. Ask for the handover note in writing before the first session, not after.
bullets: Identity, qualification and component level syllabus knowledge checked before listing
Contactable references from previous Mumbai families, not testimonial quotes
Ask which syllabus code applies and whether it changes next series
Ask the tutor to work one question from your child's last marked paper
On a handover, insist on the written note before the first session

sections.heading: Moving campus mid-year in Mumbai: the handover that decides whether the term holds
paragraphs: Here is the fact that shapes everything on this page. Malad and Chembur are not two neighbourhoods, they are two cities for the purpose of a weekly lesson. Malad is Western Line and Link Road. Chembur is Harbour Line, Central Line, the SCLR and the Eastern Freeway. There is no direct train between them; you change at Dadar or you cross by road. A tutor who serves one campus almost never serves the other, so a family that moves from one to the other is not changing address, it is changing tutoring markets. When that happens in October or January, the instinct is to go shopping for a better tutor. That instinct is wrong. The variable that decides whether the term holds is the quality of the handover, not the quality of the second tutor.

Take a concrete case. A Year 11 student is sitting IGCSE Physics and losing marks on Paper 4, the Extended written paper. Her Malad tutor has worked out, over six weeks, exactly what is wrong: given a velocity time graph and asked for the total distance travelled and then the acceleration over a named interval, she sets up the area under the graph correctly and reads the gradient correctly, then loses the final mark because the axis is in kilometres per hour and the answer is wanted in metres per second squared. Her physics is sound. Her multi step unit conversion is not. That single sentence, written down, is the whole value of six weeks of work.

If that sentence travels to the Chembur tutor, the second IB and IGCSE tutor for Witty International School students in Mumbai starts on Paper 4 unit conversion drills in session one and the student loses nothing. If it does not travel, the new tutor runs her own diagnostic, sees weak Paper 4 marks, and reasonably concludes that kinematics needs re-teaching. Three weeks go on ground she already holds, and the actual defect is still there in February. Meanwhile her Chemistry IA, with an approved research question and one round of feedback already received, must not be reopened at all; the new tutor's job there is to read and continue.

So the questions to ask when you relocate across Mumbai are not about credentials. They are: which of my child's subjects transfer cleanly and can be picked up at the point they were left, which need a fresh diagnostic because the mark depends on a coached style of response, what is written down that the next tutor can read, and who is paying for the overlap weeks. Settle those four and the second tutor can be merely good. Leave them unsettled and the best IB and IGCSE tutor in Mumbai cannot save the term, because he will spend it rediscovering what somebody already knew.
bullets: No direct rail link: Malad is Western Line, Chembur is Harbour and Central
A handover note beats a better tutor, every time, mid-year
Transfers cleanly: content knowledge, paper technique, a written error log
Needs fresh diagnostic: anything marked against a coached style of response
Never reopen an IA whose research question is already approved
Budget three or four overlap weeks rather than a clean break

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle
paragraphs: At four weeks you should not expect a mark to move, and a tutor who promises one is not being straight with you. What you should expect is evidence of diagnosis: a written list of the specific things going wrong, a changed homework pattern, and your child able to tell you what she is working on in component terms rather than saying the subject name. If none of that exists after four weeks, the placement is not working and you should say so rather than wait politely for the term to end.

At one term, marks should move at component level on past papers taken under timed conditions. Not the final grade necessarily, but the specific paper or criterion that was identified in week one. This is why the week one diagnostic matters so much: without it there is no baseline, and without a baseline any conversation about progress becomes a conversation about feelings. At one full examination cycle, a grade change is a reasonable thing to discuss. Even then, IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no tutor who has taught these boards honestly would.

When a placement is not working, tell us in writing and we replace the tutor. There is no argument and no notice period beyond the sessions already booked. The outgoing tutor writes the handover note as a condition of the placement, and the incoming tutor reads it before the first session, which is the same discipline this page argues for in a campus move. We also say no sometimes. If a student is three grades below target with eight weeks to the series, we will tell you what is achievable in eight weeks rather than sell you a package. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with Witty International School or any other school named on this page, and we do not guarantee results.
bullets: Four weeks: a written diagnosis and a changed homework pattern, not marks
One term: measurable movement on the component identified in week one
One exam cycle: a grade conversation, still without any guarantee

sections.heading: Starting home tuition in Mumbai after a campus move: what to prepare
paragraphs: Prepare five things and the first session is worth paying for. The most recent school report. The last two marked papers or drafts with the marker's comments still on them, which matters more than the report. The syllabus code for each subject, because Cambridge and the International Baccalaureate both revise specifications and the wrong code means the wrong past papers. The current stage of any coursework or Internal Assessment, including whether the topic is approved. And the school's own internal deadlines for the next term, which are the deadlines that actually bind.

The first session is a diagnostic, not a lesson, and you should want it that way. The tutor gives timed questions from the relevant paper, watches how your child works rather than whether she gets the answer, and writes down what is wrong in component terms. You get that in writing within a day or two. From there the plan covers six weeks, names the component being targeted, and says how it will be measured. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai cannot fix four subjects at once, so the plan will usually pick two.

If you are mid-move between the Malad and Chembur campuses, say so in your first message. We will shortlist on the side of Mumbai you are moving to, not the side you are leaving, and we will ask whether the outgoing tutor can stay online for three or four weeks of overlap. If there was no previous tutor, that is fine too; we simply build the baseline from the marked scripts instead of from a handover note. Either way the first session covers the same ground, and neither route involves us claiming any connection to your child's school.
bullets: Bring the report, but bring the last two marked scripts first
Confirm the syllabus code for every subject before any past paper work
State the coursework or IA stage, including whether the topic is approved
Share the school's internal deadlines for the coming term
Say if you are mid-move so we shortlist the correct side of the city

faqs.question: Is IB Gram connected to Witty International School in any way?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent tutor matching platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Witty International School. We have no access to the school's staff, teaching materials, internal mark schemes or student reports, and no tutor on our panel is presented as a current or former member of its faculty. What we work from is public information, that the school runs campuses in Malad and Chembur offering IGCSE and IB pathways, plus the published Cambridge International Education and International Baccalaureate specifications that every school on these boards follows. If you want the school's own view on subject choice, ask the school.

faqs.question: We are moving from the Malad campus to the Chembur campus in November. Do we have to change tutors?
faqs.answer: Almost certainly yes for the in person sessions, and that is a scheduling fact rather than a judgement on your tutor. Malad sits on the Western Line and the Link Road; Chembur sits on the Harbour and Central lines with the SCLR and the Eastern Freeway. There is no direct train, so a tutor crossing for a weekday evening slot will start cancelling within a month. What you should not do is simply swap one tutor for another. Keep the Malad tutor online for three or four weeks of overlap while a Chembur based tutor starts in person, both working from one written plan.

faqs.question: What exactly should a handover note contain?
faqs.answer: Five things, and it should fit on one page. First, the specific defect in component terms, for example marks lost on unit conversion in multi step IGCSE Physics Paper 4 questions rather than weak at Physics. Second, past paper scores broken down by paper or criterion, with dates. Third, the stage of any coursework or Internal Assessment, including whether the research question is approved and what feedback has already been given. Fourth, what has been tried and did not work. Fifth, the school's internal deadlines for the coming term. Ask for it in writing before the new tutor's first session, not afterwards.

faqs.question: Which subjects transfer cleanly to a new tutor and which do not?
faqs.answer: Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Economics transfer cleanly because the skill ladder is explicit and a single diagnostic session exposes the gap. A new tutor can pick these up at the exact point the previous one left off. English Language and Literature, Business Management and second languages need a genuinely fresh diagnostic, because a large part of the mark depends on a style of response the previous tutor was coaching towards, and two competent tutors can coach towards different styles. Internal assessments sit in their own category: never reopen an approved topic. The new tutor reads the existing drafts and the marker's comments, then continues from there.

faqs.question: Will a tutor actually travel to our building in Malad West on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, if we match a tutor who already works that corridor, and no reliably if we do not. This is why we filter by side of the city before anything else. A tutor living or teaching along the Western Line between Goregaon, Malad West, Malad East and Kandivali, with Metro Lines 2A and 7 above the Link Road as a fallback, will hold a 6.30pm or 7pm slot for a full term. A tutor coming from Chembur or Powai across the SCLR will manage it for a few weeks and then start asking to move the session. Book the corridor, not the resume.

faqs.question: Our society in Chembur requires a gate pass for every visitor. How does that work?
faqs.answer: Clear it once, as a standing weekly entry, rather than per visit. Most Mumbai societies will register a regular tutor for a fixed day and time if a resident requests it in writing at the office, and that single step removes the most common cause of a lost fifteen minutes. We ask tutors to carry photo identification to every session regardless. Tell us at the matching stage if your building requires prior approval for each visitor or restricts entry after a certain hour, because in Chembur, Govandi and Kurla that varies considerably between complexes and it changes which evening slots are realistic for your family.

faqs.question: What do IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Mumbai depend on?
faqs.answer: Five factors, and we will not quote a number because any figure here would be invented. Board and level: Diploma Programme Higher Level costs more than IGCSE Core. Subject scarcity: Higher Level Further Mathematics or a less common language has far fewer qualified teachers in the city than Maths or Biology. Travel distance and timing, since a tutor crossing the SCLR in the evening peak is spending time you are effectively paying for. Session length and frequency. And whether you need overlap weeks during a handover, which temporarily means two tutors. Ask for the rate per session and what happens to a cancelled session before you commit.

faqs.question: Does online tutoring really work for an IGCSE science practical paper?
faqs.answer: For the alternative to practical and practical based written papers, yes, with one condition: the student must have the paper printed and in front of her. These components test whether a student can read a results table, spot the anomalous reading, describe a control variable and evaluate a method, and all of that can be taught over a screen share. What does not work online is diagnosing handwriting, working layout and the order in which a student attacks a paper, which is exactly what the first diagnostic session is for. That is a strong argument for running the diagnostic at home even when the weekly sessions will be online.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after three sessions?
faqs.answer: Tell us in writing and we replace them, with no argument and no notice period beyond sessions already booked. Three sessions is a reasonable point to judge: by then you should have a written diagnosis, a changed homework pattern and a child who can describe what she is working on in component terms. The outgoing tutor writes a handover note as a condition of the placement, so the replacement does not start from zero. Say what specifically did not work, whether it was the explanation, the pace, the timing or simply the fit, because that is what lets us match differently rather than just match again.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Ask for the baseline and compare against it, rather than relying on impressions. At four weeks a mark should not necessarily have moved, so the question is whether the diagnosis exists and is specific. If the tutor can show you the week one timed paper, the written list of defects and this week's work targeting one of them, the placement is on track and you should give it a term. If there is no baseline paper and no written list, that is the actual problem, and no amount of extra sessions fixes it. Request a diagnostic in writing or ask us for a replacement.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover both IGCSE and IB for two children in the same family?
faqs.answer: Often in Maths and the sciences, rarely in languages and the arts. The content overlap between IGCSE Extended Maths and Diploma Programme Mathematics Analysis and Approaches at Standard Level is real, and a tutor who teaches both routinely can run back to back sessions in one visit, which is also the cheapest way to buy two children's tuition. Where it breaks down is the Internal Assessment and Extended Essay supervision, which demands familiarity with the specific criteria and the moderation culture around them. We will tell you honestly when two tutors are the better answer rather than stretch one across both boards.

faqs.question: Do you cover Govandi and Kurla, or only the larger suburbs?
faqs.answer: Yes to both, and they matter specifically for the Chembur campus. Govandi sits on the Harbour Line between Chembur and Mankhurd, and Kurla is the Central Line junction where the SCLR meets the Eastern Express Highway, which makes both of them workable for tutors already teaching in Chembur or Wadala. The honest caveat is subject depth: for a scarce Higher Level subject the local pool in these areas is thinner than in Powai or Bandra, and an online match may be the realistic option. For mainstream IGCSE and Diploma Programme subjects, a home tutor in Govandi or Kurla is straightforward to arrange.

sections.heading: How soon can an IB and IGCSE tutor near me in Oberoi Exquisite actually start?
paragraphs: Usually within the week, and the reason is geography rather than capacity. The limiting factor on a near-me request is never whether a qualified teacher exists somewhere in Mumbai. It is whether a qualified teacher has a free evening and lives close enough to spend it teaching rather than travelling. So the search is run as a proximity filter first and a subject filter second: who is already inside Oberoi Garden City, Goregaon East on a weekday evening, who is in Oberoi Esquire or Jogeshwari, and only then who among them has taught the board and the year group you need.

What that means in practice is that the honest answer to 'how soon' depends on how common the subject is. Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics and English can usually be matched for a first session within a few days because the local pool is deep. A less common second language, Music or a specialist design subject may take a fortnight, or may only be available online, and we will say that rather than send you someone who half fits because they happen to live nearby. For a widely taught subject, IB and IGCSE home tuition near me in Oberoi Exquisite is a scheduling question rather than a search problem.

sections.heading: One household, two boards: IB and IGCSE in the same towers
paragraphs: Oberoi Exquisite has a pattern most Mumbai addresses do not, and it shapes near-me searches here more than traffic does. Children in the same towers sit on both pathways at once. Some are inside the International Baccalaureate (IB) continuum, moving through the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP). Others are on a Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel route towards the International General Certificate of Secondary Education, taken across roughly Years 9 to 11. Parents with two children often need both at the same time, from the same evening, in the same flat.

The two systems demand different rhythms from a tutor and it is worth knowing which one you are buying. The IB spreads assessment through the years: internally assessed work, extended written pieces, and criteria that are reported on continuously, so the tutoring pattern is steady and deadline-shaped. The IGCSE concentrates almost everything into a terminal examination series at the end of a two-year run, so the tutoring pattern is a build followed by a sprint. A tutor who is excellent at one rhythm is not automatically good at the other, and the honest test is whether they can describe both without flattening them into the same thing.

Where the two pathways genuinely meet is the age-sixteen decision, and this is the conversation families in these towers have most often. A student finishing the IGCSE series may continue into the Diploma Programme, and a student finishing MYP may do the same from inside the IB. Both arrive in the first year of the Diploma Programme having been assessed in quite different ways, and the adjustment is real in both directions. For structure, entry requirements and current programme detail, speak to the coordinator at the school your child will actually attend; those details are revised on the schools' and the boards' own cycles, not ours.

sections.heading: Which subjects can a tutor near Oberoi Exquisite actually cover?
paragraphs: Most of them locally, and a handful only at a distance or online. The list of all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Oberoi Exquisite can be asked to cover runs across both boards and the full school range, but availability is not evenly spread. Mathematics at every level, the three sciences, Economics, Business, English and the widely taught second languages are well supplied in Goregaon East and along the Western Line. Music, some design and technology subjects, and the less commonly offered languages are scarce everywhere in the city, which is a supply fact rather than a local one.

The depth that matters is never the subject label. It is the level and the assessed component inside it. A Diploma Programme Higher Level request and a Standard Level request in the same subject are different jobs, as are a tiered IGCSE entry and an untiered one. Within each subject there is internally assessed or school-assessed work with published criteria, and reading those criteria properly with the student is often where the marks are. Ask a prospective tutor which level and which assessed component they last worked on, and ask what the student produced at the end of it.

There is a boundary on assessed work that applies to both boards, and we would rather state it here than be asked about it later. Work that the school submits as the student's own has to be the student's own. A tutor teaches the underlying skill, the structure of a write-up, the discipline of planning and the reading of criteria, and then stops. Any tutor who offers more than that is handing your child a risk that outlives the tuition, and we remove tutors who offer it.

The practical version of all this is a short brief. Name the subject, the board, the level and the next dated piece of work, and the shortlist writes itself. A request for general improvement across five subjects produces a tutor who is vaguely useful in all of them, which is the slowest way to spend a term. Most households here settle on home classes for two subjects and leave the rest to the school and the student.

sections.heading: Home tutoring, online, or hybrid when the tutor lives nearby?
paragraphs: When the tutor lives close, home tutoring stops being a preference and becomes simply the better product. An IB and IGCSE tutor near me in Oberoi Exquisite who is ten minutes away can do things a distant tutor cannot: sit with a folder of marked papers spread across the table, shift a session by a day when a deadline moves, add an extra hour before a mock without renegotiating the week, and arrive in the monsoon. Those are not small conveniences. They are most of the difference between a tutoring arrangement that lasts a year and one that quietly stops in September.

Online tutoring has a specific and genuine job even here. It is how a scarce subject gets covered at all, so an IB and IGCSE online tutor in Oberoi Exquisite is the right answer when the specialist you need teaches from another city. It is also the sensible format for a short pre-deadline check, a drill on a topic list, or a week when the student is unwell but not too unwell to work. The honest limitation is attention: younger students and anyone who needs a person in the room to stay on task lose more than the convenience is worth.

Hybrid is where most households with two children end up, and proximity makes it work better. One long home session a week, where the tutor is physically present with both the IB child's draft and the IGCSE child's marked paper, plus short online slots in the weeks either child has something due. The trade-off to watch is drift. A nearby tutor who is easy to reach can end up answering messages instead of teaching, which feels generous and achieves less than a protected half hour on a call.

There is a particular risk in a complex where everybody knows everybody, and it is worth naming. The tutor recommended by a neighbour in the next tower is near, available and already trusted socially, and none of that is evidence about teaching. Ask the same questions you would ask a stranger: which board, which year group, which recent series or session, what they will send you after each session, and what they would do in the first three weeks. Sit in on the first session rather than leaving the flat, and listen for diagnosis instead of reassurance. A good first hour includes the tutor reading your child's actual work and telling you something slightly uncomfortable about where the gap is. Be wary of anyone who offers a guaranteed grade, who blames the school's marking before reading a marked script, or who wants a term paid up front before a trial.

sections.heading: What a nearby tutor is genuinely worth, and what it costs you in Mumbai
paragraphs: The value of a tutor who lives nearby is almost entirely about frequency and recovery, not about the hour itself. A tutor fifty minutes away delivers the sessions on the calendar and nothing more. A tutor fifteen minutes away delivers those, plus the rescheduled one after a school trip, plus an extra hour the weekend before a mock, plus a Saturday morning in the fortnight when two deadlines collide. Over a year that difference is substantial, and it never appears in the hourly rate. For an IB and IGCSE tutor near me in Oberoi Exquisite, that recovery capacity is the real product.

The cost of insisting on proximity is a narrower pool, and the narrowing bites unevenly. For Mathematics it costs you almost nothing. For a Higher Level subject with a demanding internal assessment, or for a board your school runs in only two subjects, it can cost you the specialist entirely. The sensible structure for most families is mixed: local tutors for the subjects where weekly consistency matters most, and a willingness to travel or go online for the one subject where depth is scarce. Insisting on the first ring for everything is how parents end up with a pleasant tutor who cannot read a mark scheme. Mixed is also how most home tuition arrangements in these towers look by the end of a year.

IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Oberoi Exquisite depend on things you can actually check, and a page that quotes a figure is inventing one. Board and level, because a final-year Higher Level subject in assessment season is a different job from middle-school support. Subject scarcity, which is why a Music tutor and a Mathematics tutor are not comparable. Travel distance and the time of day, which is the one factor proximity directly improves. Session length, and whether this is a standing weekly commitment or a short intensive. Ask for the per-session rate in writing before the trial, and agree what a late cancellation costs.

One last trade-off specific to a complex like this one. A tutor who teaches several children in the same towers is reliable and cheap to schedule, and you should still ask directly about discretion. Marks, reports and difficulties travel fast in a compound where the families share a lift lobby and a school gate, and a professional tutor will have a clear answer about what they do not discuss. If the answer is vague, that is information.

sections.heading: What should a nearby tutor show you in a month, a term and a year?
paragraphs: In the first month the measurable thing is delivery, and a near-me arrangement should be judged on it harder than a distant one. Home classes bought partly for their convenience have to actually be convenient, and the test is the attendance record rather than the promise. Count the sessions that happened against the sessions that were booked, and count the ones that started on the hour. A tutor fifteen minutes away has no excuse for a pattern of late arrivals, and a pattern in month one becomes a habit by month three. Alongside that, you want a short written note after each session telling you what was covered and what is weak. Three lines is enough; nothing is not.

By the end of a term the evidence should be coming from the school rather than from the tutor. For an IB child that looks like a criterion moving, a draft the teacher accepted, or a piece of internally assessed work scoped properly rather than rewritten twice. For an IGCSE child it looks like a timed paper finished, working laid out legibly, and marks lost to content rather than to confusion about the question. Progress is usually uneven across subjects and criteria, and a report that improves in two places and stands still in a third is a normal term.

Over a full year the claim worth making is narrow and we would rather make it than oversell. Tutoring improves preparation, technique, organisation and the quality of work a student produces under their own steam, which are the parts within a student's control. It does not control the paper that appears, the moderation, the boundaries for that series, or how a sixteen year old feels on the morning. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no tutor who understands either board will tell you otherwise.

If it is not working, the fix is a message rather than an argument, and it should come at session three or four. Replacing an IB and IGCSE home tutor near me in Oberoi Exquisite is quicker than replacing one brought in from across the city, because the ring that produced the first name has not been used up. Tell us whether the problem was pace, temperament or board knowledge, and the next profile is better aimed. The incoming tutor picks up the existing notes and marked work rather than starting the diagnosis again.

faqs.question: How close does a tutor actually live if I search for a tutor near me in Oberoi Exquisite?

faqs.question: Can one tutor teach my IB child and my IGCSE child in the same visit?
faqs.answer: For the same subject, often yes, and it is the most efficient arrangement available to a household in these towers. faqs.question: Does a tutor who lives nearby cost less?

faqs.question: Do I need to be at home while the session is happening?

After that most families are present in the home without supervising the session, which is the right balance for a teenager. Home tuition at your own table is easier to supervise lightly than a session somewhere else, which is part of the point of it.

faqs.question: What happens if we need to move a session at short notice?

Agree the rule in advance anyway: how much notice is expected, whether a moved session is made up or forfeited, and whether a short online slot can stand in. faqs.question: Is a tutor near me better than a bigger institute further away?
faqs.answer: For most families here, yes, and the reason is attendance rather than teaching quality. A good institute in Andheri or Malad can be excellent and still lose you a term, because a child who travels forty minutes each way twice a week after school eventually stops going. One-to-one teaching at your own table removes the journey entirely and keeps the hour. The genuine case for travelling further is a scarce subject or a specific specialist, and in that situation an online arrangement is usually the better compromise.

faqs.question: My child is in the Diploma Programme and my younger one starts the IGCSE next year. Where do we begin?
faqs.answer: Begin with the one who has a dated deadline, which is almost always the older child. Final-year internal assessment work and the examination session are immovable, while a Year 9 start has room to be planned properly in the holidays. Book the Diploma Programme subject first, and use the same conversation to put the younger child's subject choices on the table with a tutor who has taught both boards. Planning the IGCSE entry early is worth far more than extra tuition in Year 11.

faqs.question: How many tutors should we try before deciding?
faqs.answer: One, in most cases, and a second if the first is clearly wrong. Trialling several people in parallel sounds thorough and in practice unsettles the student, because each tutor restarts the diagnosis and nothing gets built. Pick the profile whose board and year-group experience matches most closely, run one trial session, and judge it on whether the tutor read your child's work and named a specific weakness. If that did not happen, ask for the next profile rather than a second opinion on the same one.

If you already know a subject will need support, start the conversation in the first term. Scarce subjects are worse again: for those, availability is measured in terms rather than in weeks.

faqs.answer: Both, across the full school range on either pathway. Requests for younger children in these towers are usually about reading, writing stamina and number confidence, and middle-school requests are often about criterion-referenced reports that parents cannot interpret. The exam years bring subject depth, assessed coursework and timing under pressure. The tutor pool differs by stage, because teaching a nine year old and teaching a final-year student are separate skills that rarely sit in the same person.

sections.heading: IB and IGCSE are two different supply markets in the same city
paragraphs: Parents treat the two boards as one shopping trip, and tutor supply does not. The International Baccalaureate (IB) runs the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP), while Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel run IGCSE at Years 9 to 11 followed by A Levels. A tutor who is fluent in IGCSE Years 9-11 content is not automatically fluent in Diploma Programme assessment, and the gap shows up in the first fortnight rather than at the exam.

The practical effect on supply is this. IGCSE tutors are the broader pool, because the content overlaps enough with other boards that a strong subject teacher can cross over with reading. Diploma Programme tutors are narrower, because the internal assessment structure, the command terms and the markbands are specific and cannot be guessed. Middle Years Programme tutors are the narrowest of all, because MYP criteria A to D are assessed differently from anything else taught in this city, and plenty of experienced teachers have never written an MYP task-specific clarification.

That narrowing is why the same postcode can feel rich and poor at once. A family in Malad West looking for IGCSE Maths has choices. The same family looking for Diploma Programme Economics Higher Level with real IA supervision experience may find the nearest credible person sits in Andheri or Juhu. The pin on the map did not move. The pool behind it did.

So when you search for an IB and IGCSE tutor Mumbai parents rate, be specific about which of the two you mean and at which stage. An IB and IGCSE private tutor Mumbai families hire for an MYP Year 9 child and the person they hire for a DP2 candidate three months from final exams are rarely the same person, and asking for both in one request produces a slower, worse shortlist.

sections.heading: Which Mumbai subjects have a deep bench and which have almost none
paragraphs: Subject scarcity is the second map nobody shows you. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Mumbai can plausibly be found, but the depth behind each name varies enormously. Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics and English are the deep benches: in the dense pockets there are several credible people for each, so you can afford to reject one on style alone. Business Management, Psychology, Computer Science, Global Politics and Environmental Systems and Societies are thinner. Visual Arts, Film, Music and the Group 2 languages beyond Hindi, French and Spanish are thin everywhere in the city.

The internal assessments are where that scarcity bites hardest. A Diploma Programme Physics Internal Assessment (IA) needs a supervisor who understands uncertainty propagation and the difference between a method that produces data and a method that produces a defensible gradient. A Mathematics Analysis and Approaches Higher Level exploration needs someone who can tell a student that their topic has no mathematics in it yet, in October, when there is still time to change it. A History IA needs a reader who can mark the investigation's evaluation of sources properly rather than praising the research.

On the IGCSE side the equivalents are the coursework and practical components: the Cambridge Physics alternative-to-practical paper, the Edexcel Maths calculator and non-calculator split, the English Language coursework folder, and the long-answer structure in Biology that students lose marks on for reasons nothing to do with knowledge. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai schools offer does not exist as one person, and anybody advertising as that is telling you something.

Subject choice itself is worth a session before any tutoring starts. Higher Level versus Standard Level, Core versus Extended at IGCSE, and the combination of six Diploma subjects with Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) on top is a decision with four years of consequence. A good tutor will tell you when a subject should be dropped a level rather than propped up at the level it is at, and that conversation usually saves more marks than a term of sessions.

sections.heading: Where does the international-school belt actually run across Mumbai?
paragraphs: Mumbai's IB and IGCSE schools sit in a broken belt, not a spread, and tutor supply sits on top of it. In South Mumbai the belt is tight and old: Cuffe Parade, Colaba, Fort, Babulnath, Walkeshwar, Peddar Road and Tardeo hold B.D. Somani International School, the Cathedral and John Connon School, Bombay International School, Gopi Birla Memorial School, Activity High School and Aditya Birla World Academy within a few kilometres of each other, with Worli and Prabhadevi at the northern edge. Home tuition here is matched inside the island because the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals make an evening crossing from the suburbs unreliable.

The Western Suburbs carry the densest stretch. Bandra Kurla Complex holds Dhirubhai Ambani International School, the American School of Bombay and Ascend International School; Juhu holds Ecole Mondiale World School, Jamnabai Narsee International School and Utpal Shanghvi Global School; and the belt continues through Santacruz West, Khar West, Vile Parle, Andheri West and Oshiwara up to Goregaon East, Malad West, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar East. Supply here runs north to south along the Western Line, the Western Express Highway and Metro Lines 2A and 7, so Khar to Santacruz matches easily and Bandra to Kandivali does not.

In the Central Suburbs the belt narrows to a knot. Powai and Chandivali are thick with tutors because Hiranandani Foundation School and a Podar International School campus pull them there, and because Metro Line 1 and JVLR connect them to Andheri East and Ghatkopar. Kurla and Ghatkopar sit on the Central Line with real supply. In the Eastern Suburbs, Chembur has a JBCN International School campus and a Witty International School campus and therefore a pool; Wadala and Vikhroli ride the Eastern Freeway and the Monorail into it; Mulund West has NES International School. Govandi, a short distance from Chembur, has very little of its own.

Across the creek in Navi Mumbai the belt is node-shaped. Nerul holds D.Y. Patil International School, and Vashi, Belapur, Seawoods, Kharghar, Airoli and Panvel sit on Palm Beach Road, the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1. The Atal Setu has shortened the drive from the island city, but a weekday evening crossing still rarely holds for a full term. Thane runs its own market from the station out along Pokhran Road, Majiwada, Hiranandani Estate and Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, anchored by Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School, and in Mumbai, Maharashtra there is no other suburb where a single road sets the timetable so completely.

sections.heading: What the Mumbai school calendar does to tutor availability
paragraphs: The international schools in this city share a rhythm, and that rhythm decides when the tutors near you are free. The academic year opens in the first half of June, which is also when parents who spent May deciding finally start calling. Everyone wants Tuesday and Thursday at seven. The good tutors in the dense pockets fill their weekday evening grid in the first three weeks of term, and what remains after that is Saturday mornings, Sunday afternoons and the slots nobody wants.

The pressure points then fall in a predictable order. October brings Diploma Programme Internal Assessment drafts and Extended Essay first submissions alongside MYP interim reports. November and December bring mock examinations at most IB and IGCSE schools, and demand spikes hard enough that families searching then are usually choosing between whoever is left rather than whoever is best for the child. January and February are the Theory of Knowledge essay and the final IA deadlines. March starts the Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel IGCSE series and the Diploma Programme May session, by which point adding a new tutor is damage limitation rather than teaching.

Schools also stack their own calendars on top. A BKC or Juhu campus running a parent-teacher conference week, a Model United Nations, a school production or a sports week will move three or four evening slots in a single fortnight, and in a building where several children attend the same school, the tutor loses the whole evening rather than one lesson. That is a scheduling fact worth knowing before you promise a tutor a fixed weekly slot.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page, with the International Baccalaureate organisation, with Cambridge International Education or with Pearson Edexcel. Schools are named here because their calendars and their locations shape what a Mumbai family can realistically book, and for no other reason.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid when the belt is far from your flat
paragraphs: Home tuition is the first choice for most families who search IB IGCSE tutor near me in Mumbai, and for good reason. A tutor sitting at your dining table sees the child's actual working conditions: the textbook they never opened, the calculator they cannot drive, the phone face-up beside the notebook. An IB and IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai also absorbs the travel cost that you would otherwise pay in a child's time, which on a Tuesday evening between Andheri and Bandra is not a small number. If you live inside the belt, book home sessions and stop reading here.

If you live off the belt, the honest arithmetic changes. A tutor who spends ninety minutes travelling for a ninety-minute lesson will either charge for the travel, quietly shorten the session, or drop you in November when a closer family offers the same slot. That is not bad faith; it is a person protecting their evening. IB and IGCSE home tuition in Mumbai works beautifully in Khar West and painfully in a sector of Panvel with no international school within reach, and pretending otherwise is how arrangements collapse mid-term.

Online is the honest answer for scarce subjects and thin pockets. An IB and IGCSE online tutor in Mumbai can be the person in Powai who has supervised eleven Physics IAs, rather than the generalist twenty minutes from your gate. For essay subjects, IA drafting, past-paper marking and anything screen-shareable, online loses very little. For a Year 9 child who needs somebody physically present to stop them drifting, it loses a great deal, and no amount of good software fixes that.

Hybrid is what most off-belt families settle into and it is underrated. One home session a week for presence, accountability and the parts that need paper, plus one shorter online session for marking and question practice. The travelling tutor gets one trip instead of two and stays through the year; the child still gets face-to-face contact; the scarce subject specialist becomes reachable from Kasarvadavali or Kharghar without anybody driving across the city twice a week.

sections.heading: Who is the home tutor at your door, and what was checked?
paragraphs: Before a tutor is shown to a family, three things are verified: identity against a government photo identity document, the board and syllabus they claim to have taught, and the teaching history they describe. Board experience is checked against the syllabus itself rather than against a resume line, because a candidate who cannot describe the current assessment structure of the course they claim to teach has not taught it recently. Subject depth is checked separately from board familiarity, since the two come apart constantly.

There are checks we cannot run and you should know which. We cannot verify a private tutoring result that was never recorded by a school. We cannot confirm what somebody did in another family's living room. We cannot certify character. Anyone searching for an IB IGCSE tutor near me in Mumbai should treat a platform that claims to have verified all of that as either confused or careless, and should keep doing the parts that only a parent can do.

Your own checks are short and they matter more than ours. Ask the tutor to describe the assessment structure of your child's exact course without looking it up. Ask what they would do in the first three sessions, and listen for whether the answer is a diagnosis or a syllabus march. Ask how they mark a draft, and whether they write on it. Sit within earshot of the first two sessions, not in the room, and listen for whether the child is talking or only listening.

Finally, be clear about what verification does not buy. We do not guarantee grades, because nobody honestly can; the work between sessions belongs to the student, and a verified, experienced, well-matched tutor working with a child who does not do the practice will produce a disappointing result. What checking buys is the removal of the avoidable failures, which is worth doing and is not the same as a promise.
bullets: Government photo identity document checked before any introduction
Board claims tested against current syllabus and assessment structure
Subject depth assessed separately from board familiarity
Ask the tutor to outline their first three sessions, unprompted
Sit within earshot of the first two sessions, not in the room

sections.heading: Why is tutor supply thick in Powai and thin four kilometres away?
paragraphs: Because tutors cluster around schools, not around people. A specialist IB or IGCSE tutor needs enough families within a short travel radius to fill four or five weekday evenings; otherwise the work is not viable and they teach something else or move online. Those families exist in volume only where an international school already exists, because that is where the children sitting those syllabuses live. So the pool forms around Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, around the Juhu campuses, around Bandra Kurla Complex, around the Chembur and Mulund West schools, and it does not form in a residential pocket of identical size with no such school nearby, however many flats were sold there last year.

This is why population is the wrong predictor. A new tower cluster off Ghodbunder Road may hold more households than Walkeshwar, and still have a fraction of the IB and IGCSE tutors, because its children are bussed out to Thane and Mulund campuses and the tutor economy stayed where the schools are. Two families four kilometres apart therefore have completely different experiences of the identical IB IGCSE tutor near me in Mumbai search for home tuition. The one in Khar West gets four names in a day and complains about choosing. The one across the creek in Kharghar gets one name and a question about Saturdays, and concludes the platform is weak when what they have met is the city's geography.

It also has consequences before any tutoring question arises. If you are choosing where to live and your child is heading into the Diploma Programme, the tutoring pool around an address is a real and rarely mentioned part of its value, and it tracks the schools, not the amenities. If you are choosing between two schools in different zones, you are also choosing between two tutoring markets, and the thinner one will cost you in availability later even if the fees and the campus look similar today.

Searching from a thin pocket is a different technique, not a lost cause. Widen the radius deliberately to the nearest belt point and ask for the slot that suits the tutor's direction of travel rather than your preference, usually the first or last lesson of their evening. Offer one longer session rather than two short ones. Accept a weekend morning, which is when off-belt arrangements actually survive. Take the scarce subject online and keep the common subject at home. Families searching for IB and IGCSE tutors near me Mumbai from Panvel, Dahisar East, Govandi or Kasarvadavali who do these four things end up with a better tutor than neighbours who insisted on a Tuesday at seven and took whoever was willing.

sections.heading: What progress should look like by the first half-term
paragraphs: At four weeks you are not looking for marks. You are looking for three things: the child can state what they are bad at in specific terms rather than saying the subject is hard, homework arguments have reduced, and the tutor can tell you something about your child that you did not already know. If a tutor has taught eight sessions and their report is that your daughter is improving and needs to practise more, you have hired a presence rather than a teacher, and you should say so directly before the term runs out.

At one term the measure changes to behaviour under exam conditions. A Diploma Programme student should be finishing papers in the time allowed, not leaving the last question blank because the earlier ones ate the clock. An IGCSE Years 9-11 student should be structuring long answers to the mark allocation rather than writing everything they know. Internal Assessment drafts should exist in writing, with the tutor's comments on them, and you should be able to read those comments and understand what changed between draft one and draft two.

At one examination cycle, the result is the result, and it is influenced by far more than the tutoring. Illness in March, a subject chosen at the wrong level in Year 11, a school that changed teachers mid-course, a student who did the sessions and not the practice: all of these move an outcome more than a good tutor can. We do not guarantee grades and you should be wary of anyone in this city who does, especially in November when parents are anxious and promises are cheap.

If it is not working, say so in week three rather than week ten. A replacement is arranged without an argument and without anybody having to justify themselves; the usual honest answer is that the diagnosis was right and the personality fit was wrong, which is nobody's failure. The slower and more expensive mistake is the home tuition arrangement everybody can see is dead that runs until March because changing it felt rude.

sections.heading: Booking IB and IGCSE home tuition in Mumbai: what to have ready
paragraphs: Four things make the first message useful. Your child's board and exact year group, written as the school writes it. The subjects, with Higher Level, Standard Level, Core or Extended stated where it applies. Your address or society name, because the locality decides the pool and the tower decides the gate protocol. The two or three evening windows that genuinely work, allowing for school buses that reach Kandivali East or Kharghar later than the parents expect.

Two things make it better. The most recent school report or mark sheet, including the teacher comments that parents usually skim, since a comment about not attempting the extended-response questions tells a tutor more than the grade above it does. And a one-line statement of what you actually want, which is often not what you first say: catching up a term of missed Chemistry, surviving mocks, getting an Extended Essay out of a stalled draft, or rebuilding a child's confidence after a bad Year 10.

The first session is a diagnostic. The tutor works through recent school material and recent errors, establishes what the child can do unaided, and sends you a short written note saying what they found and what the next six sessions will address. If that note is vague, that is information about the tutor and you should act on it rather than wait. You are not committed to a term by sitting one diagnostic session, and no sensible tutor expects you to be.

If your pin sits in a thin pocket, send the request anyway and say so in the message. The answer may be a tutor from the nearest belt point on a weekend morning, a hybrid week, or an online specialist for the hard subject. It will be a real answer with the trade-off named, which is more useful than a longer list of people who were never going to drive to your gate in the first place.

faqs.question: Why do I get so few results when I search for a tutor near me in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Almost always because your address sits off the international-school belt rather than because the city is short of tutors. IB and IGCSE tutors cluster where the schools are, since that is where enough families live to fill their weekday evenings. A pin in Khar West or Powai returns several names; a pin in a newer pocket of Panvel or off Ghodbunder Road may return one. The fix is to widen the radius to the nearest belt point, take the slot that suits the tutor's travel direction, and move the scarcest subject online.

faqs.question: Is a tutor who lives closer better than one who is further away?
faqs.answer: No, and this is the most expensive assumption parents make. Proximity only matters because it predicts whether the arrangement survives the year. A tutor twenty minutes away with no Diploma Programme Internal Assessment experience will cost your child more than a specialist who takes forty minutes to arrive and therefore comes once a week instead of twice. Judge the subject and board fit first, then ask whether the travel is sustainable in November, and build the week around the answer rather than around the map.

faqs.question: What do IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Mumbai depend on?
faqs.answer: Five things, and none of them are fixed across the city. The board and level, since Diploma Programme Higher Level sits above IGCSE Years 9-11 in every pool. The subject's scarcity, which is why Physics and Economics cost differently from English. The travel involved, which is the single biggest reason an off-belt address quotes higher than a Bandra West one. Session length and weekly frequency. And how close to the examination series you are booking. We publish no price list because an honest one would need all five inputs.

faqs.question: Will a tutor really come to our building on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the travel works for them, and this is worth settling before the first session rather than after. A home tutor who already teaches in your complex or the next one will take a weekday evening easily. A tutor crossing the Western Express Highway at 6pm, or coming up Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, will manage one trip a week comfortably and two reluctantly. Ask directly how they are travelling and at what time they expect to arrive, and build in the twenty minutes that Mumbai will take from them anyway.

faqs.question: What does our society need to do about gate access for a home tutor?
faqs.answer: Get the tutor on a standing visitor entry rather than a fresh pass every week. Most large Mumbai complexes allow a recurring entry for a named regular visitor once a resident registers them, which removes the ten-minute call-up at the gate that otherwise eats the start of every session. Give the tutor the tower and flat number in writing, tell them which gate actually admits visitors after seven, and warn them if the parking is outside. These sound trivial and they are the most common cause of a home tuition session starting late.

faqs.question: Does one of us need to be at home during the session?
faqs.answer: Not for the whole session, but be in the flat for the first two. Sit within earshot rather than in the room. You are listening for whether your child is talking or only nodding, whether the tutor is explaining or lecturing, and whether the hour has a shape. After that, your presence usually makes a teenager quieter and less willing to admit they do not understand something. What you should keep is the written note at the end of each session and a short conversation with the tutor every few weeks.

faqs.question: My child goes to a school in BKC but we live in Chembur. Where should I look?
faqs.answer: Look near home, not near school, unless the tutoring happens immediately after the school day. The Eastern Freeway and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road make that journey manageable at some hours and miserable at others, and a tutor who teaches near Dhirubhai Ambani International School has no reason to cross to Chembur for a single evening lesson. Chembur has its own pool around the JBCN International School and Witty International School campuses there. Use it, and keep the BKC connection for an online specialist if a scarce subject needs one.

faqs.question: Can online tuition really work for IB Internal Assessments?
faqs.answer: For most of the drafting and feedback work, yes, and often better than home sessions. Screen-shared drafts with live comments, shared spreadsheets for data analysis, and marked past papers returned as annotated files all work cleanly. What online does not replace is the physical practical work behind a Physics or Chemistry IA, the discipline a younger student needs from somebody in the room, and the diagnostic value of a tutor seeing the chaos of a real desk. Hybrid solves most of this: home for presence, online for marking.

faqs.question: How quickly can you find an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai for us?
faqs.answer: For a common subject at a dense address, usually within a day or two. For a scarce Higher Level subject at a thin address, longer, and we will tell you that at the start instead of sending a weak match quickly. The honest variable is not our speed but your pin and your subject. If the pool near you is two people, you will hear that it is two, along with the options that widening the radius, changing the evening or going hybrid would open up.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after a month?
faqs.answer: Tell us in week three rather than week ten and a replacement is arranged without you having to build a case. Say what actually happened in the sessions rather than what you think of the tutor: the child was silent, no written feedback arrived, the hour had no plan, the sessions became homework supervision. That description makes the next match better. Most failed arrangements in this city are fit failures rather than competence failures, and nobody needs to be blamed for the second match to work.

faqs.question: We are moving house in Mumbai. Should the tutoring pool affect where we look?
faqs.answer: If your child is entering the Middle Years Programme or the Diploma Programme, yes, and almost nobody factors it in. Tutor supply follows the international schools, so an address within reach of the Juhu, BKC, Powai, Chembur or Nerul clusters has a working market around it, while a comparable address with no such school nearby does not, regardless of how large the development is. It is not a reason to choose a flat on its own. It is a real cost that shows up in Year 11 when you need a specialist on a Tuesday.

faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, nor with the International Baccalaureate organisation, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. Schools are named because their locations and calendars decide what a family in a given Mumbai locality can realistically book, which is the whole point of this page. We also do not guarantee grades. What we arrange is a checked, subject-matched tutor and an honest account of what the pool around your address actually contains.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram shortlist an IB IGCSE tutor in Mumbai who teaches both?
paragraphs: A request for an IB IGCSE tutor in Mumbai is treated as two separate briefs from the first call. The evidence that somebody teaches International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) classes well is not the same evidence that they teach the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) well. One record is built against a published specification and a mark scheme. The other is built against assessment criteria and a long piece of work the student owns. A profile that says only both boards, all subjects tells a parent nothing, so we do not forward it in that state.

The sequence is deliberately short. 1. We take the subject, the board, the year group and the exam series the child is actually sitting, in those words. 2. We ask which of the two boards is the urgent one this term, because one almost always is, and the honest answer shapes everything after it. 3. We pull tutors whose stated teaching record covers that board at that level rather than the qualification next to it. 4. We ask each shortlisted tutor to describe one piece of student work they have marked in that exact qualification and what they wrote on it. 5. We send two or three profiles with the board history written on the front, and the parent chooses.

Step four is where most dual-board claims come apart, and it is the cheapest check available to anybody. A tutor who has marked IGCSE Chemistry Paper 4 can tell you what loses marks on a six-mark extended-response question without pausing. A tutor who has marked DP Chemistry can tell you what separates a weak and a strong piece of personal engagement in an Internal Assessment (IA). A tutor who has done only one of those two things will answer the other question in generalities about concepts and confidence. Generalities are the signal.

If nobody in a parent's immediate area has a verifiable record in both, we say so rather than stretching a profile to fit. Sometimes the right answer in Kharghar or Mulund West is one strong IGCSE specialist now and a separate DP specialist named in advance for later. Sometimes it is a single tutor who travels further for a standing weekly slot. Both of those are better outcomes than a confident profile that collapses in week three.

sections.heading: Teaching IGCSE and teaching the Diploma Programme are two different jobs
paragraphs: At IGCSE, the tutor's job is coverage against a document. Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel both publish a specification, a set of command terms and past papers with mark schemes, and a strong IGCSE tutor knows the whole surface of that document. They know which topics appear in Paper 2 and which only in Paper 4, which command words want a definition and which want a comparison, and how a marker awards a point that a student has written in the wrong order. The work is broad, structured and heavily paper-driven.

At Diploma Higher Level (HL), the tutor's job changes shape. The syllabus is narrower and much deeper, a substantial share of the grade sits in internal work that one student produces alone over months, and the marking runs on criteria that reward judgement rather than recall. A DP tutor spends time on question formulation, on whether a method actually answers the question asked, on evaluation that goes beyond listing limitations, and on the difference between a student describing a result and a student interpreting one. That is a supervisory skill as much as a teaching skill.

Standard Level (SL) sits between the two in content but not in habit. An SL course still carries an IA, still uses criteria, and still expects independent work. Plenty of tutors who are confident with SL content are uncomfortable supervising the IA attached to it, which is why we ask about the internal component separately from the taught content. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) are a third skill again, closer to supervision than to subject teaching, and very few subject tutors claim all three honestly.

This is why a tutor who crosses both boards is rarer than advertising suggests. It is not a question of intelligence or qualifications. It is that the two roles reward different working habits, and most tutors have genuinely spent their hours in one of them. A tutor who has taught IGCSE for several years and read the DP guide is not a DP tutor. A tutor who supervises DP IAs every year and has not opened an IGCSE mark scheme recently will under-prepare a Year 11 student for the exact phrasing of a paper.

sections.heading: Which subjects actually cross both boards, and which only look like they do?
paragraphs: Mathematics crosses most cleanly. Algebraic fluency, functions, trigonometry and calculus groundwork run continuously, and a tutor strong in IGCSE Extended Mathematics usually has the technical range to teach Analysis and Approaches at Standard Level. The honest caveat is the Mathematics IA, the exploration, which asks a student to choose and develop their own mathematical question. Technical strength does not automatically produce the ability to steer a sixteen-year-old away from an exploration topic that has no real mathematics in it. When a parent asks about covering all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Mumbai claims to teach, Mathematics is where the claim is most often true.

The sciences cross least cleanly, and this surprises families. IGCSE Physics, Chemistry and Biology are examined through structured papers with a practical component assessed on paper, while the DP sciences carry a single internally assessed investigation marked on criteria covering research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. A tutor can be excellent at drilling IGCSE Chemistry calculation questions and still have never helped a student design a controlled investigation with a defensible range of values. Ask specifically about the internal component, by name, for each science.

English and the humanities split differently again. IGCSE First Language English rewards a controlled response to a passage under timed conditions. DP English Language and Literature asks for sustained analysis of texts and a Higher Level essay that develops a line of argument over weeks. Economics, Business Management and Psychology all have IGCSE or equivalent versions that reward structured recall and DP versions that reward applied evaluation against criteria. A tutor who says they teach all of these at both boards should be able to name the internal assessment attached to each one without being prompted.

Subject choice itself is where families most want a view. Whether a child takes Core or Extended at IGCSE, and whether a DP subject is taken at Higher or Standard Level, both affect how much tutoring time a subject realistically needs. We ask tutors to be straight about this rather than agreeable. A tutor who says every subject is fine at Higher Level is not being helpful, and a tutor who talks a student down from a subject they want without a specific reason is not being helpful either.

sections.heading: Finding an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai zone by zone
paragraphs: Dual-board tutors are a smaller pool than single-board tutors, so geography bites harder on this request than on most. In South Mumbai, families in Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Peddar Road, Tardeo and Fort are served almost entirely from within the island. The distances look trivial and the evening signals at Peddar Road and Haji Ali are not, so a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba can lose a large part of a slot to eight kilometres of road. Metro Line 3 and the Coastal Road have changed some of those crossings, but a standing 6pm slot is still best filled locally.

In the Western Suburbs the usable rule is to match along the Western Line rather than across it. Bandra to Khar West, Santacruz to Juhu, Andheri West to Goregaon East, Malad to Kandivali and Borivali to Dahisar all work as repeating weekday arrangements. Pulling a tutor from Bandra to Kandivali at 6pm on the Western Express Highway does not, whatever both sides agree to in week one. Metro Lines 2A and 7 have made the Dahisar to Andheri corridor more workable for an evening return journey, which matters when the pool for a specific subject is thin.

The Central and Eastern Suburbs behave as one travel problem with two shapes. Powai and Chandivali sit on JVLR with no station of their own, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar. Kurla, Vikhroli, Bhandup and Mulund run on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway. Chembur, Govandi and Wadala are served by the Harbour Line and the Eastern Freeway, which makes South Mumbai far closer from Chembur than the map implies. When parents type IB and IGCSE tutors near me Mumbai into a phone at nine in the evening, this is the layer the phrase near me is really asking about.

Navi Mumbai and Thane need node matching. Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar, Panvel and Airoli are each a short drive from the next along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, and the Atal Setu has shortened the island crossing considerably, but a tutor brought across the creek for a weekday evening rarely sustains it for a full term. In Thane, Ghodbunder Road sets the timetable: a tutor near the station reaches Kasarvadavali quickly off-peak and slowly at 7pm, so Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Hiranandani Estate are matched separately from the Ghodbunder stretch. Finding an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai is far more about honest travel time than about the straight-line distance a parent sees on a map.

sections.heading: Which Mumbai school calendars does a dual-board tutor hold at once?
paragraphs: A tutor working across both boards is holding two calendars that peak at different moments, and that is a scheduling reality more than an academic one. IGCSE candidates in Mumbai sit the main series in May and June, with mocks concentrated in January and February and coursework or practical deadlines clustered before them. DP candidates sitting the May session face internal deadlines through the preceding October to February, then a mock series, then study leave. The two sets of pressure do not overlap neatly, which is both the problem and the opportunity.

Families across the city feel this through their own school's dates. Dhirubhai Ambani International School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in BKC and Juhu, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Activity High School on Peddar Road and Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo all set their own internal deadline rhythm. So do Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu, Oberoi International School on JVLR, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, the JBCN International School campuses at Parel, Borivali, Oshiwara and Chembur, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page, nor with the International Baccalaureate organisation, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. School names appear here only because they set the calendar a tutor has to work around, and because a parent reading this page wants to know the tutor understands the rhythm their child is actually living in.

The practical consequence for a dual-board tutor is that the two boards compete for the same January. Mock exams for one and internal deadlines for the other land in the same weeks, and a tutor holding both has to decide in advance which one gets the extra hour. The useful tutors say this out loud in November and agree the trade with the family, rather than discovering it in the second week of January when nothing can be moved.
bullets: IGCSE peaks at January mocks and the May and June written series
DP internal deadlines run October to February before the May session
January is the collision month for any tutor holding both boards
